pr_body:
Running multiple hdfs fixtures in parallel for running integration tests requires
a dynamic port assignment in order to avoid port clashes. This introduces
the ability to assign port ranges to gradle projects that can be used
to allocate dynamically ports used by these projects.

We apply this dynamic port setup for hdfs fixtures used in
`:x-pack:plugin:searchable-snapshots:qa `only at the moment as
tests sources (rest tests) in `:plugins:repository-hdfs` still rely on
hard coded ports.

This is a simplified version of fixtures I created before on the gradle codebase 
to deal with similar issues.

Fixes #66377
pr_title: Allow dynamic port allocation for hdfs fixture
pr_comment: Merging to unblock others from CI failures.

review_comment: From what I can tell `assignePort` and `releasePort` are never used. Is there something that needs to be still wired up?
kind of an oversight. I remove this as it's not used at the moment
What's the motivation for having these port ranges per-project? Why not just allocate a single big block for the entire build?
I remember we introduced these ranges in gradle too, to make debugging this a bit easier. I don't have hard feelings or strong opinions here. I like the separation between projects though.
